blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Inheritance) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 A plant that produces all offspring with the same trait upon self-fertilization is called:
(Jo paudha self-fertilization (khud-zarkhezi) par tamam aulad mein wohi trait (sifat) paida kare, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: True-breeding (pure-breeding) paudha self-fertilization par tamam aulad mein wohi trait deta hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: produces all the offspring with the same trait upon self-fertilization

blocks.prompt:
2 In his first monohybrid crosses, Mendel observed the inheritance of:
(Apne pehle monohybrid crosses mein Mendel ne kis cheez ki wirasat dekhi?)
blocks.explanation: Mendel ke pehle monohybrid crosses mein seed shape (beej ki shakal) dekhi gayi: round × wrinkled se F1 mein sab round beej aaye (18.1).

book_ref.quote: In the first monohybrid crosses, he observed the inheritance of

blocks.prompt:
3 The alternative trait that was not expressed in the F1 plants was called by Mendel:
(Jo mutabadil trait F1 paudon mein zahir nahi hua, Mendel ne use kya naam diya?)
blocks.explanation: F1 mein zahir hone wala trait (round) dominant tha; jo zahir nahi hua (wrinkled) woh recessive kehlaya (18.1).

book_ref.quote: the alternative trait that was not expressed in the F1 plants

blocks.prompt:
4 Mendel's results suggested that the 3:1 ratio of the F2 generation was really a disguised:
(Mendel ke nataij ke mutabiq F2 ka 3:1 ratio asal mein chhupa hua kaun sa ratio tha?)
blocks.explanation: F2 ka 3:1 asal mein 1:2:1 tha: 1/4 pure-breeding dominant, 2/4 ghair pure-breeding dominant, 1/4 pure-breeding recessive (18.1).

book_ref.quote: the 3:1 ratio in F2 generation was really a disguised 1:2:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
5 In Mendel's F2 generation, the fraction that was dominant but NOT pure-breeding was:
(Mendel ki F2 generation mein kitna hissa dominant tha lekin pure-breeding nahi tha?)
blocks.explanation: F2 mein 1/4 pure-breeding dominant, 2/4 ghair pure-breeding dominant aur 1/4 pure-breeding recessive the (18.1).

book_ref.quote: 2/4 were not pure-breeding dominant

blocks.prompt:
6 The chromosomal theory of inheritance was proposed in 1902 by:
(Chromosomal theory of inheritance (wirasat ka chromosomi nazariya) 1902 mein kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1902 mein American scientist Walter Sutton ne chromosomal theory of inheritance pesh ki (18.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1902, American scientist Walter Sutton proposed the chromosomal theory of inheritance

blocks.prompt:
7 The German geneticist who rediscovered Mendel's work in 1900 and suggested the role of chromosomes in heredity was:
(Woh German geneticist kaun tha jis ne 1900 mein Mendel ka kaam dobara dhoonda aur heredity mein chromosomes ka kirdar bataya?)
blocks.explanation: 1900 mein Karl Correns ne Mendel ka kaam dobara dhoonda aur heredity mein chromosomes ka kirdar bataya (18.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1900, German geneticist Karl Correns, rediscovered

blocks.prompt:
8 According to the chromosomal theory, Mendel's laws are explained by the behaviour of chromosomes during:
(Chromosomal theory ke mutabiq Mendel ke qawaneen kis dauran chromosomes ke rawaiye se samajh aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nazariye ke mutabiq genes chromosomes par khaas jagahon par hain aur meiosis mein chromosomes ka rawaiya Mendel ke qawaneen ki wazahat karta hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: The behaviour of chromosomes during meiosis explains

blocks.prompt:
9 Mendel concluded that the trait which 'disappeared' in the F1 hybrids:
(Mendel ne kya natija nikala ke F1 hybrids mein 'ghaib' hone wala trait:)

options.text: paudon se hamesha ke liye khatam ho gaya
sirf F3 mein dobara zahir hua
F1 beejon mein chhupa tha aur F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein wapas aaya

blocks.explanation: Jo trait F1 mein zahir nahi hua woh F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein wapas aaya, is liye woh F1 beejon mein chhupa hua tha (18.1).

book_ref.quote: must therefore be disguised in the F1 seeds

blocks.prompt:
10 Mendel's special 'factors' that control the characters of organisms are now called:
(Mendel ke khaas 'factors' jo jandaron ki sifaat control karte hain, aaj kal kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mendel ne kaha sifaat khaas 'factors' control karte hain jinhein ab genes kehte hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: which are now called genes

blocks.prompt:
11 The alternative forms of a gene, leading to alternative traits, are called:
(Gene ki mutabadil shaklein jo mutabadil traits paida karti hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gene ki tamam copies aik jaisi nahi hotin; is ki mutabadil shaklein alleles kehlati hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: The alternative forms of a gene, leading to alternative traits, are called alleles

blocks.prompt:
12 The particular location of a gene on a chromosome is called its:
(Chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah us ka locus (maqam) hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: The particular location of a gene on a chromosome is called the gene

blocks.prompt:
13 An offspring formed by the fusion of two gametes carrying the same allele is:
(Aik hi allele wale do gametes ke milap se banne wali aulad kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaise alleles wale gametes milein to aulad homozygous, mukhtalif alleles hon to heterozygous hoti hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Such offspring is called homozygous for that gene pair or trait

blocks.prompt:
14 Which statement correctly relates genotype and phenotype?
(Genotype aur phenotype ka sahi talluq kaun sa bayan batata hai?)

options.text: Phenotype naqsha hai; genotype zahiri natija hai
Dono ka matlab alleles ka majmua hai
Genotype naqsha hai; phenotype zahiri natija hai

blocks.explanation: Alleles ka majmua genotype (naqsha) hai; nazar aane wali sifat phenotype (zahiri natija) hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: the genotype is the blueprint, and the phenotype is the visible outcome

blocks.prompt:
15 A gene is now defined as a sequence of nucleotides, as part of DNA, which codes for the formation of a:
(Aaj gene ki definition: DNA ka hissa nucleotides ka silsila jo kis cheez ki banawat ka code deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene 'DNA ka hissa nucleotides ka silsila hai jo polypeptide banane ka code deta hai' (18.1).

book_ref.quote: which codes for the formation of a polypeptide

blocks.prompt:
16 The principle that each gamete receives just one allele of a gene, selected randomly, is the:
(Yeh usool ke har gamete ko gene ka sirf aik allele milta hai jo ittefaqan chuna jata hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gametes bante waqt har aik ko aik allele ittefaqan milta hai; yeh law of segregation hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: each gamete receives just one gene copy (allele), which is selected randomly

blocks.prompt:
17 In a testcross, an individual with a dominant phenotype is crossed with:
(Testcross mein dominant phenotype wale fard ko kis se cross kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Testcross se pata chalta hai ke dominant phenotype homozygous hai ya heterozygous; is ke liye use recessive phenotype se cross karte hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: It involves crossing the dominant phenotype with a recessive phenotype

blocks.prompt:
18 A round-seeded plant crossed with a wrinkled-seeded plant (rr) gives round and wrinkled offspring in a 1:1 ratio. The round parent was:
(Round beej wala paudha wrinkled (rr) se cross karne par round aur wrinkled aulad 1:1 mein deta hai. Round parent kya tha?)
blocks.explanation: Testcross mein Rr paudha round aur wrinkled 1:1 deta hai, jabke RR paudha sab round (Rr) deta hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: If it is Rr, the offspring will be round and wrinkled in a 1:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
19 The F1 plants of the cross RRYY × rryy are called dihybrids because they:
(RRYY × rryy cross ke F1 paude dihybrids kyun kehlate hain?)

options.text: dono genes ke liye homozygous hain
dono genes ke liye heterozygous hain
sex chromosomes ke do jore rakhte hain

blocks.explanation: Tamam F1 beej (RrYy) round aur yellow aur dono genes ke liye heterozygous the, is liye dihybrids kehlate hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: These F1 plants are called dihybrids, as they are heterozygous for both genes

blocks.prompt:
20 How many kinds of gametes does an F1 dihybrid plant (RrYy) produce?
(F1 dihybrid paudha (RrYy) kitni qisam ke gametes banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: RrYy paudha chaar qisam ke gametes banata hai: RY, Ry, rY aur ry (18.2).

book_ref.quote: During gamete formation, four combinations are produced: RY, Ry, rY, ry

blocks.prompt:
21 When the gametes of two F1 dihybrids combine, the number of combinations formed in F2 is:
(Do F1 dihybrids ke gametes milne se F2 mein kitne combinations bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: 4 male × 4 female gametes se F2 mein 16 combinations bante hain jo chaar phenotypes 9:3:3:1 mein dete hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: 16 combinations are formed in the F2 generation

blocks.prompt:
22 In Mendel's dihybrid F2 (9:3:3:1), the phenotype in the smallest class '1' is:
(Mendel ke dihybrid F2 (9:3:3:1) mein sab se chhoti class '1' ka phenotype kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: F2 ratio 9 round yellow : 3 round green : 3 wrinkled yellow : 1 wrinkled green hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: This results in four phenotypes in F2 in a 9:3:3:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
23 In the F2 of Mendel's dihybrid cross, round versus wrinkled seeds considered alone show the ratio:
(Mendel ke dihybrid cross ke F2 mein sirf round aur wrinkled beej alag se dekhein to ratio kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Independent assortment har allele jore ki segregation par asar nahi karta, is liye round:wrinkled 3:1 aur yellow:green bhi 3:1 hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: Thus, round vs wrinkled seeds show a 3:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
24 The modern re-statement of Mendel's law of independent assortment is that genes assort independently during meiosis when they are:
(Mendel ke law of independent assortment ka jadeed bayan: genes meiosis mein azadana kab assort hote hain?)

options.text: aik chromosome par qareeb qareeb hon

blocks.explanation: Jadeed bayan: 'jo genes mukhtalif chromosomes par hon woh meiosis mein azadana assort hote hain' (18.2).

book_ref.quote: genes that are located on different chromosomes assort independently during meiosis

blocks.prompt:
25 Independent assortment happens because during meiosis:
(Independent assortment is liye hota hai ke meiosis ke dauran:)

options.text: homologous chromosome jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain
sister chromatids aapas mein jur jate hain
genes aik chromosome se doosre par chale jate hain
sirf baap ke chromosomes gametes mein jate hain

blocks.explanation: Meiosis mein homologous jore ittefaqi tor par qatar banate hain, is se gametes mein maan aur baap ke alleles ke mukhtalif combinations bante hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: homologous chromosome pairs line up randomly during meiosis

blocks.prompt:
26 In humans, the random alignment of 23 chromosome pairs can produce allele combinations in one gamete numbering over:
(Insaan mein 23 chromosome jore ki ittefaqi tarteeb aik gamete mein kitne se zyada allele combinations bana sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan mein independent assortment aik gamete mein 8 million (2²³) se zyada mumkin combinations bana sakta hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: In humans, it can produce over 8 million

blocks.text: 18.2.1 Limitations to the Law of Independent Assortment

blocks.prompt:
27 Genes close together on the same chromosome are often inherited together, not independently. This is called:
(Aik hi chromosome par qareeb genes aksar azadana nahi balke ikatthe wirasat mein jate hain. Ise kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik chromosome par qareeb genes ikatthe jate hain; is ko gene linkage kehte hain (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Genes close together on the same chromosome are often inherited together

blocks.prompt:
28 The phenomenon in which one gene controls multiple characters is:
(Woh amal jis mein aik gene kai sifaat control karta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Pleiotropy: aik gene kai sifaat control karta hai, jis se independent assortment ke mutawaqqa ratios badal sakte hain (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: It is the phenomenon where one gene controls multiple characters

blocks.prompt:
29 Chromosome crossover, a limitation to independent assortment, is the exchange of genetic material between:
(Chromosome crossover, jo independent assortment ki aik had hai, kin ke darmiyan genetic maadde ka tabadla hai?)

options.text: fertilization par X aur Y chromosomes

blocks.explanation: Chromosome crossover meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan genetic maadde ka tabadla hai (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: It is the exchange of genetic material between homologous chromosomes during meiosis

blocks.prompt:
30 For a cross like AaBbCcDdEe × AaBbCcDdEe, outcomes are worked out with probability rules because:
(AaBbCcDdEe × AaBbCcDdEe jaise cross ke nataij probability ke usoolon se kyun nikale jate hain?)

options.text: Punnett square bohat pecheeda ho jata hai
probability sirf zyada genes par chalti hai
Punnett square ghalat ratio deta hai

blocks.explanation: Aik do genes ke liye Punnett square theek hai; zyada genes ke liye woh bohat pecheeda ho jata hai, is liye probability ke usool istemal hote hain (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: So, probability rules are used instead

blocks.prompt:
31 Green pea seeds appear 600 times out of 2,400 seeds. The probability of a green seed is:
(2,400 beejon mein se 600 dafa green beej aata hai. Green beej ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Probability = waqia kitni dafa hua ÷ kul nataij = 600 ÷ 2,400 = 0.25, yani 4 mein se 1 (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Probability is calculated by dividing the number of times an event occurs

blocks.prompt:
32 The chance of two or more independent events happening together is found by:
(Do ya zyada azad waqiat ke aik saath hone ka imkan kaise nikalte hain?)

options.text: alag probabilities ko jama kar ke
bari mein se chhoti tafreeq kar ke
alag probabilities ko zarb de kar (product rule)
aik ko doosri se taqseem kar ke

blocks.explanation: Product rule: azad waqiat ke ikatthe hone ka imkan = un ki alag alag probabilities ka hasil-e-zarb (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: the chance of two or more independent events happening together is calculated by multiplying

blocks.prompt:
33 In the cross RrYy × RrYy, the probability of a wrinkled green (rryy) offspring is:
(RrYy × RrYy cross mein wrinkled green (rryy) aulad ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: P(wrinkled) = 1/4 aur P(green) = 1/4; product rule se P(rryy) = (1/4) × (1/4) = 1/16 (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Probability of Round seed = 3/4, Probability of yellow seed = 3/4

blocks.prompt:
34 In the cross RrYy × RrYy, the probability of a round green offspring is:
(RrYy × RrYy cross mein round green aulad ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: P(round) = 3/4 aur P(green) = 1/4, is liye P(round green) = (3/4) × (1/4) = 3/16 (product rule, 18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The product rule can be used to predict fertilization outcomes

blocks.prompt:
35 Three dice are rolled together. The chance of getting three sixes is:
(Teen dice aik saath phenke jayein. Teeno par six aane ka imkan kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har dice par six ki probability 1/6 hai; teen azad dice ke liye (1/6) × (1/6) × (1/6) = 1/216 (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: For two dice, the chance of getting two sixes is

blocks.prompt:
36 In the cross AaBbCc × AaBbCc (genes assorting independently), the probability of an aabbcc offspring is:
(AaBbCc × AaBbCc cross mein (genes azadana assort hon) aabbcc aulad ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har gene ke liye P(recessive homozygote) = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4; teen genes ke liye (1/4) × (1/4) × (1/4) = 1/64 (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Each parent has a 1/2 chance of giving gamete with allele a

blocks.prompt:
37 The sum rule of probability applies to events that are:
(Probability ka sum rule kin waqiat par lagta hai?)

options.text: azad aur aik saath hone wale
mutually exclusive (aik waqt mein sirf aik)

blocks.explanation: Sum rule un waqiat par lagta hai jin mein aik waqt mein sirf aik ho sakta hai; kisi bhi aik ki probability un ka jama hai (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: This rule applies to mutually exclusive events

blocks.prompt:
38 In the cross Aa × Aa, the probability of a heterozygous (Aa) offspring, worked out with the sum rule, is:
(Aa × Aa cross mein sum rule se heterozygous (Aa) aulad ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aa do tareeqon se banta hai (male se A + female se a, male se a + female se A), har aik 1/4: 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2 (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: In a cross Aa × Aa, dominant phenotype (AA or Aa) can occur in three ways

blocks.prompt:
39 In a Yy pea plant, Y is fully expressed and y is not expressed at all. This is:
(Yy matar ke paude mein Y poori tarah zahir hota hai aur y bilkul nahi. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab dominant allele poora zahir ho aur recessive bilkul nahi to yeh complete dominance hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: This is called complete dominance

blocks.prompt:
40 When a heterozygous individual shows a phenotype intermediate between those of both parents, the inheritance is:
(Jab heterozygous fard dono parents ke darmiyan wala phenotype dikhaye to yeh kaun si wirasat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Incomplete dominance mein koi allele poora dominant nahi, is liye heterozygote darmiyani hota hai, jaise four-o'clock ke pink phool (18.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the heterozygous individual shows a phenotype that is intermediate between phenotypes of both parents

blocks.prompt:
41 In Japanese four-o'clock plants, a cross of red (RR) × white (WW) gives F1 offspring that are:
(Japanese four-o'clock mein red (RR) × white (WW) cross se F1 aulad kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Red × white se tamam heterozygous pink (RW) aulad aati hai; is se pata chalta hai ke na R na W poora dominant hai (18.3.1).

book_ref.quote: it produces all heterozygous pink flowered (RW) offspring

blocks.prompt:
42 In four-o'clock plants, a cross between two pink plants gives red, pink and white offspring in the ratio:
(Four-o'clock mein do pink paudon ke cross se red, pink aur white aulad kis ratio mein aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: RW × RW se red (RR), pink (RW) aur white (WW) 1:2:1 mein aate hain; genotype aur phenotype ratio aik hi hai (18.3.1).

book_ref.quote: When two pink flowered plants (RW × RW) are crossed

blocks.prompt:
43 The type of inheritance in which both alleles of a gene pair are fully expressed in a heterozygote, without blending, is:
(Woh wirasat jis mein heterozygote mein gene jore ke dono alleles bina milawat poori tarah zahir hon:)
blocks.explanation: Co-dominance mein dono alleles bina milawat ya chhupaye kaam karte hain, is liye heterozygote mein dono ki paidawar nazar aati hai (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: both alleles in a gene pair are fully expressed in a heterozygous individual

blocks.prompt:
44 In the MN blood group alleles Lᴹ and Lᴺ, the letter 'L' stands for:
(MN blood group ke alleles Lᴹ aur Lᴺ mein 'L' kis ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: 'L' Landsteiner aur Levine ke liye hai jinhon ne MN system 1927 mein daryaft kiya (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: the scientists who discovered this system in 1927

blocks.prompt:
45 The MN system is also called the MNS system because:
(MN system ko MNS system bhi kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: is ke teen co-dominant alleles M, N aur S hain
MN aur S/s ke genes aik chromosome par linked hain
S AB logon ka antigen hai

blocks.explanation: Ise MNS kehte hain kyunke MN group aur S/s group ke genes aik hi chromosome par linked hain (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: It is also called the MNS system because the genes of MN group

blocks.prompt:
46 A person with genotype LᴹLᴺ has blood group:
(LᴹLᴺ genotype wale shakhs ka blood group kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lᴹ aur Lᴺ co-dominant hain, is liye LᴹLᴺ mein M aur N dono antigens hain: blood group MN (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: individuals with both M and N antigens

blocks.prompt:
47 In which pattern do the two genes of a heterozygote blend their phenotypic effects?
(Kis pattern mein heterozygote ke dono genes apne asraat ko mila dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Incomplete dominance mein genes apne asraat mila dete hain; co-dominance mein dono poore zahir hote hain (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: In heterozygous state, both genes blend their phenotypic effects

blocks.prompt:
48 Which pair are both examples of co-dominance?
(Kaun sa jora dono co-dominance ki misalein hain?)

options.text: Human MN blood group and human AB blood group
Four-o'clock flower colour and AB blood group
Wheat grain colour and MN blood group
Labrador coat colour and Rh blood group

blocks.explanation: Comparison table mein human MN aur AB blood groups co-dominance ki misalein hain; four-o'clock ka rang incomplete dominance hai (18.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Example: Human MN blood group and human AB blood group

blocks.prompt:
49 A multiple allelic system occurs when, in a population, a gene has:
(Multiple allelic system tab hota hai jab population mein aik gene ke:)

options.text: alleles sirf do chromosomes par hon

blocks.explanation: Multiple allelic system: population mein gene ki do se zyada shaklein (alleles) hon, jis se zyada variation (tanawwo) aata hai (18.3.3).

book_ref.quote: occurs when a gene has more than two alternative forms (alleles) in a population

blocks.prompt:
50 Out of the three alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ and i, the number of alleles carried by one person is:
(Teen alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i mein se aik shakhs kitne alleles rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Population mein I gene ke teen alleles hain magar har shakhs mein sirf do hote hain (18.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Each person has only two of these alleles

blocks.prompt:
51 The three alleles of the I gene, in different combinations, produce how many ABO blood groups?
(I gene ke teen alleles mukhtalif combinations mein kitne ABO blood groups banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i ke combinations chaar blood groups banate hain: A, B, AB aur O (18.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Different combinations produce four blood groups

blocks.prompt:
52 The International Society of Blood Transfusion recognizes how many blood group systems in humans?
(International Society of Blood Transfusion insaanon mein kitne blood group systems tasleem karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: International Society of Blood Transfusion insaanon mein 43 blood group systems tasleem karti hai (18.4).

book_ref.quote: recognizes 43 blood group systems in humans

blocks.prompt:
53 In blood group systems, the antigens on the surface of RBCs may be:
(Blood group systems mein RBCs ki satah par antigens kya ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: RBCs ki satah ke antigens proteins, carbohydrates, glycoproteins ya glycolipids ho sakte hain (18.4).

book_ref.quote: the antigens present on the surface of RBCs may be proteins

blocks.prompt:
54 For blood transfusion, the donor's and recipient's blood must be matched for:
(Blood transfusion ke liye donor aur recipient ka khoon kin systems mein milana zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: ABO sab se ahem aur Rh doosra ahem system hai; transfusion ke liye dono milana zaroori hai (18.4).

book_ref.quote: the matching of ABO and Rh-system is necessary

blocks.prompt:
55 The antigens Luᵃ and Luᵇ belong to which blood group system?
(Luᵃ aur Luᵇ antigens kis blood group system se talluq rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre bare systems ke table mein Lutheran ke antigens Luᵃ aur Luᵇ hain; yeh aam tor par transfusion mein masla nahi banate (18.4).

book_ref.quote: these usually do not cause matching problems in the blood transfusions

blocks.prompt:
56 Antigens K, k, Kpᵃ, Kpᵇ, Jsᵃ and Jsᵇ belong to the:
(Antigens K, k, Kpᵃ, Kpᵇ, Jsᵃ aur Jsᵇ kis system ke hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table mein K, k, Kpᵃ, Kpᵇ, Jsᵃ aur Jsᵇ Kell system ke mashhoor antigens hain (18.4).

book_ref.quote: The following are the other major blood group system

blocks.prompt:
57 The ABO blood group system was discovered by Landsteiner in:
(Landsteiner ne ABO blood group system kab daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Landsteiner ne 1901 mein ABO system daryaft kiya aur RBCs par antigen-A aur antigen-B paye (18.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The ABO system was discovered by Landsteiner in 1901

blocks.prompt:
58 People who secrete antigens A and B in saliva, tears and urine possess a dominant secretor gene 'Se' on chromosome:
(Jo log saliva, aansu aur peshab mein antigens A aur B kharij karte hain un mein dominant secretor gene 'Se' kis chromosome par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secretors mein dominant secretor gene 'Se' chromosome 19 par hota hai (18.4.1).

book_ref.quote: They possess a dominant secretor gene

blocks.prompt:
